title: The King Clone creosote ring
text: A ring of creosote bushes in the Mojave Desert near Lucerne Valley is estimated to be 11,700 years old. The ring is a single clonal colony, one plant that has spread outward over thousands of years. It was identified and dated by Frank Vasek, a professor at the University of California, Riverside.
